shortage.def: Shortage (excess demand): at a price below equilibrium, the amount by which quantity demanded exceeds quantity supplied. It pushes the price up.

surplus-goods.def: Surplus of a good (excess supply): at a price above equilibrium, the amount by which quantity supplied exceeds quantity demanded. It pushes the price down. Not the same as consumer or producer surplus.

double-shift.def: Simultaneous shifts: demand and supply shifting at the same time. The change both shifts agree on is certain; the other is indeterminate, meaning it depends on which shift is larger.
